summary: The overflow path now checks next.length against maxEntries before calling renderRows, so a multiline paste into a full group reports the limit and leaves every existing row intact.

evidence: In public/admin_projects.js lines 143-146, an overflowing replacement list sets the limit status and returns true before renderRows, so no rows are replaced or truncated.
The paste handler at lines 205-210 calls event.preventDefault whenever pasteRows returns true, so rejected multiline clipboard text is not inserted into the target input.
For a full 50-row group, pasting the target value plus one extra line produces 51 entries and follows the rejection path, preserving all 50 existing rows.
